dossiers.thesis_summary: BridgeBio holds a hard, binding FDA PDUFA target action date of 2026-11-27 for oral BBP-418 in LGMD2I/R9 — NDA accepted with Priority Review on 2026-05-27, no advisory committee planned, Phase 3 FORTIFY having met all primary and secondary endpoints at the 12-month interim. If approved it is the first therapy for any form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy. The event is genuinely idiosyncratic (resolves on FDA action, not the tape) and unfired at 80 days out. Critically, though, this is NOT a single-asset binary: BBIO is a $14.7B commercial-stage company whose value is dominated by the acoramidis/Attruby ATTR-CM franchise (Q2-26 US net product revenue $222.4M, +211% YoY; total revenue $243.7M; $1B+ global 2026 guidance), with two further NDAs pending (encaleret PDUFA 2027-05-08; infigratinib submitted Q3-26). My reproducible sum-of-parts puts risked BBP-418 at only ~$6.6/sh of a $74.84 price, so the PDUFA is a dated, hard, but LOW-AMPLITUDE event — the de-risk increment on approval is ~$1.2/sh, not a re-rating.
dossiers.dated_milestone: 2026-11-27 — FDA PDUFA target action date for BBP-418 (LGMD2I/R9); Priority Review, no advisory committee meeting planned
dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim I tried hardest to refute is not "is the catalyst real" (it is — confirmed against the 2026-05-27 acceptance release, the corresponding 8-K, and the Q2-26 10-Q/earnings release, with no slippage or CRL) but "does the catalyst carry meaningful, attributable upside." That claim largely FAILS. BBP-418 is ~$6.6/sh risked of a $74.84 price (~3.5% of a $14.7B market cap); converting the residual ~15% approval risk adds only ~$1.2/sh. Over the 80-day window the P&L will be dominated by Attruby quarterly prints, the Aug-31 US-government MFN/Medicaid pricing agreement flowing through net price, KKR/Frazier supply overhang (5.0M-share secondary priced 2026-08-14; Frazier cut its stake 55% in Q2), and the biotech tape — NOT by the PDUFA. So the position passes the idiosyncratic test on the EVENT but fails it on P&L attribution, which is the sleeve's actual risk. Secondary residuals: (1) my $88 target is ~19% below the 22-analyst median of $108.50 — if the street's higher acoramidis peak/multiple is right I am under-targeting, but I can only defend what I can reproduce; (2) the Aug-31 MFN agreement is a new, unmodeled net-price headwind to the single largest SoP component and post-dates every number in the board dossier; (3) BBP-418's ribitol-substrate CMC is novel, which is why I hold win_prob at 0.85 rather than the ~0.90 that priority review plus clean pivotal data plus no AdCom would otherwise support.

dossiers.dossier_note:
CATALYST — CONFIRMED PENDING_HARD, UNFIRED, UN-SLIPPED. FDA accepted the BBP-418 NDA for LGMD2I/R9 with Priority Review on 2026-05-27 and set a PDUFA target action date of 2026-11-27; FDA stated it is not currently planning an advisory committee meeting. Re-verified 2026-09-08 against the acceptance release, the corresponding 8-K, and the Q2-26 earnings release/10-Q (filed 2026-08-10), which reaffirms "the first PDUFA date is set for November 27, 2026." No 8-K, press release, or filing through 2026-09-08 indicates a review extension, major amendment, information request, or CRL. 80 days to milestone. staging=false (dated, binding).

DRIVER CORRECTION. Board tagged FDA_clinical_readout; corrected to FDA_approval_decision. FORTIFY read out before the NDA was filed — glycosylated alpha-DG +1.8x (p<0.0001), 82% CK reduction (p<0.0001), motor/pulmonary gains at the 12-month interim. What remains is an FDA action on an accepted application. This matters for the deterministic <=2-per-driver cap: BBIO must compete for a seat against other approval decisions, not against data readouts.

VALUATION AXES — method = sop (not binary_prob). Board emitted no numbers at all, so these are originated, not corrected. Share count 195.9M (= $14.658B cap / $74.84).
  Win leg / fair_value_target $88.0:
    acoramidis franchise, 2027E revenue-to-BBIO ~$1.70B (Q2-26 US net $222.4M, adding ~$35M/qtr sequentially -> ~$1.6B 2027 US net; plus ~$110M Beyonttra ex-US royalty via Bayer EU / Alexion Japan, run-rating from $15.4M in Q2) at 6.5x sales = $11.05B = $56.4/sh
    + BBP-418 unrisked post-approval (~$600M US/EU peak, 3x peak, ultra-rare ~$500K/yr pricing on a ~2-3K addressable US population) ~$1.53B = $7.8/sh
    + encaleret risked (blockbuster-framed, PDUFA 2027-05-08, ~80% PoS, discounted) ~$1.96B = $10.0/sh
    + infigratinib risked (oral vs BioMarin Voxzogo injectable, ~75% PoS, discounted) ~$2.15B = $11.0/sh
    + net financial position ~$0.55B = $2.8/sh (pro-forma ~$1.7B cash less the $1.0B preferred treated as a claim ahead of common until it converts at ~$138)
    = 56.4 + 7.8 + 10.0 + 11.0 + 2.8 = $88.0
  Lose leg / downside_floor $60.0: CRL zeroes the BBP-418 credit and de-rates the acoramidis multiple 6.5x -> 5.5x on contagion to the two other pending NDAs ($9.35B = $47.7/sh), halves the encaleret+infigratinib credit ($21.0 -> $10.5/sh), keeps net financial $2.8/sh = $61.0, rounded to $60. This is a BOUNDED tail, not a wipeout — the board skeptic was right on that point and is now MORE right: a real commercial franchise plus ~$1.7B pro-forma liquidity. Cross-check: $60 sits above the $48.78 52-week low, which I regard as a stale-low print from before Attruby tripled.
  win_prob 0.85. R:R at $74.84 = +$13.16 / -$14.84 = 0.89:1 raw; probability-weighted EV = 0.85(+17.6%) + 0.15(-19.8%) = +12.0%.

ENTRY DEGRADATION — the single most important correction for the CRO. At the board's $66.80 (asof 2026-06-13) the same axes gave +31.7% up / -10.2% down and EV ~+25%. At $74.84 they give +17.6% / -19.8% and EV ~+12%. The catalyst is fully intact; the PRICE is not. Roughly half the modelled edge was spent in the 87 days the dossier sat stale.

STREET GAP, DISCLOSED. My reproducible SoP of $88 is ~19% below the 22-analyst median target of $108.50 (consensus $109.08, range $97-130, last-month average $106.71 across 7 revisions). The gap is entirely in the acoramidis peak/multiple — the street models a larger ATTR-CM peak than I can defend from the current run-rate. I emit $88 because it is what I can reproduce; the CRO should treat $108.50 as the bull anchor, not as my number.

TAKEOUT LENS (bio/pharma) — NO LIFT APPLIED. BBIO fits the 2026 regime profile (commercially-ready, late-stage, first-in-class rare-disease assets) and the strategic logic is real: Pfizer faces Vyndaqel/Vyndamax LOE toward the end of the decade and acoramidis is the leading next-gen near-complete TTR stabilizer; Bayer (EU) and Alexion/AstraZeneca (Japan) already hold Beyonttra commercial rights, making them natural acquirers. But per the standing rule I did NOT lift fair_value_target: I could not verify a NAMED comparable takeout at this size band ($14.7B+) with date and value from the live record in this pass, and comp provenance is required before a lift. Two counterweights: the 2026-07-01 $1.0B preferred raise at a ~$138 conversion (>100% premium to 30-day VWAP) reads as financing independence rather than a sale process, and takeout here is undated optionality stacked on top of the dated event — never a substitute for it. Regime cuts both ways: with the biotech tape near multi-year highs, market-implied approval probability is already rich (my SoP shows the current price embedding near-full credit), so this is not a max-fear entry.

NEW MATERIAL FACTS THE BOARD NEVER SAW: (1) encaleret NDA accepted 2026-07-22, Priority Review, PDUFA 2027-05-08, no AdCom; (2) infigratinib PROPEL 3 published in NEJM 2026-06-28, NDA submitted Q3-26, launch targeted mid-2027 — "three launches in 12 months"; (3) 2026-08-31 voluntary US-government MFN/Medicaid pricing agreement lowering net price to expand access — an unmodeled headwind to the largest SoP component; (4) $1.0B preferred equity closed 2026-07-01, cash $720.2M at 6/30 -> ~$1.7B pro-forma; (5) KKR 5.0M-share secondary priced 2026-08-14 and Frazier -55% in Q2 (supply overhang, non-dilutive).

cro.live_edge_check: Live $74.84 (FMP quote endpoint, 2026-09-08 close; corroborated by IBKR last 74.84 on contract 372849723). Recomputed against the fresh_dossier axes (FV $88 / floor $60): up +$13.16 = +17.6%, down -$14.84 = -19.8%, raw R:R = 0.89:1 — the risk leg is now LARGER than the reward leg. The board mark was $66.80 (asof 2026-06-13), which on the identical axes gave +31.7% / -10.2% = 3.11:1. Today's 0.89:1 is 29% of that, far below the ~half-R:R kill line: solving (88-P)/(P-60) >= 1.55 puts the last acceptable entry at ~$70.98, and the tape is $3.86 above it. The +12.0% move in the 87 days the dossier sat stale spent the edge. Second, independent surface-1 failure — event AMPLITUDE, not valuation: the dossier's own reproducible SoP risks BBP-418 at ~$6.6/sh of a $74.84 price, so a clean approval converts only the residual ~15% risk = ~+$1.2/sh, about +1.6%. The dated event I am underwriting is worth ~1.6% against a 19.8% adverse leg; over the 80-day window the P&L is dominated by Attruby quarterly prints, the 2026-08-31 MFN/Medicaid net-price agreement (unmodeled, hits the largest SoP component), and the KKR 5.0M-share secondary priced 2026-08-14 / Frazier -55% overhang. That is a spread that does not pay for its own variance, which is a sleeve test, not a cheapness test.

cro.window_note: PDUFA 2026-11-27, 80 days out. Date CONFIRMED un-slipped: set at the 2026-05-27 Priority Review acceptance, reaffirmed in the Q2-26 10-Q filed 2026-08-10, and a news sweep from 2026-08-25 to today shows no 8-K, press release, or filing signalling a review extension, major amendment, information request, or CRL — only the MFN agreement, ASCEND-ATTR dosing, acoramidis 42-month CMR data, and the ESPE infigratinib presentation. No AdCom planned, so no AdCom-date slippage vector. THE OPTION WINDOW IS A TRAP, and worth recording even though the instrument is equity: IBKR lists monthlies 2026-09-18, 2026-10-16, 2026-11-20, then 2027-01-15 — there is NO December 2026 monthly. Nov 20 expires SEVEN DAYS BEFORE the PDUFA, so the obvious 'next monthly' is the one that dies just short of the event. The first clearing expiry is Jan 15 '27 (+49 days margin), and the only true +1-past-it expiry is Feb 19 '27 — both in the illiquid regime described above. Equity carries no expiry, so the window itself does not kill this name; surface 1 does.
cro.driver_confirmed: CORRECTED and confirmed: FDA_approval_decision, not the board's FDA_clinical_readout. Phase 3 FORTIFY already read out pre-NDA (glycosylated alpha-DG +1.8x p<0.0001, 82% CK reduction p<0.0001, motor/pulmonary gains at the 12-month interim); what remains on 2026-11-27 is an FDA action on an already-accepted application, which is a different risk shape from a data event. Sole name in this batch, so no same-driver collision to flag for the Director. Note for future batches: BBIO now carries a SECOND dated approval decision on the same driver — encaleret, NDA accepted 2026-07-22, Priority Review, PDUFA 2027-05-08, no AdCom — so a later encaleret nomination would be the same driver AND the same issuer.
conditions: NOT a conditional trade — this is a clean NO_TRADE on surface 1 (edge at entry). Listed only as the re-nomination trigger: the name would clear the half-R:R test again at <= ~$70.98 on the current $88/$60 axes, i.e. roughly a 5.2% pullback from $74.84.

Any re-nomination must first re-underwrite the $88 target for the 2026-08-31 MFN/Medicaid net-price agreement, which post-dates the SoP and hits the acoramidis franchise — the $56.4/sh component that is 64% of the target.

Takeout optionality (Pfizer Vyndaqel LOE, Bayer/Alexion holding ex-US Beyonttra rights) was correctly NOT lifted into the target by the dossier for want of a named, dated, valued comp. Per the standing rule it cannot rescue a failing edge test, and it does not rescue this one.
